note: The standard simulation and probe protocol applied to every twin (lengths in mm unless the key says m; angles in deg; times in s).

sim.note: mjOption is reset to MuJoCo's defaults first (density, viscosity, wind, magnetic, flags, o_* overrides), then these values are applied. tolerance 1e-10: with a kinematic body (armature 1e4) in a contact island, the Newton solver stopped early at 1e-8 and light items rocked (a 15 g box on the 0.6 deg drawer floor moved 0.3-0.5 mm / 0.5 deg in 10 s); at 1e-10 it stays within 0.012 mm, at the same cost

classes.note: items touch items, furniture and the drawer; the drawer never touches the furniture; visual geoms (contype = conaffinity = 0) stay non-colliding

kinematic.note: driven or held bodies get this armature on their dofs (then mj_setConst) and have qpos/qvel written before every step; every other dof has no armature, damping or friction loss, every joint no stiffness, every body no gravity compensation, every geom no surface velocity, adhesion or fluid coefficients

settle.note: motion is sampled at every step

static.note: an item is static when, over the settle, the displacement of its collision-geometry centroid stays within pos_mm and its rotation within rot_deg (maxima over every step)

measure.point: collision-geometry centroid (geom centres weighted by the volume of their bounding boxes; the body COM for an item without colliding geoms)
measure.rotation: angle of the body's rotation relative to the start (frame-independent)

drawer.out_direction: the joint direction that moves the drawer toward photo_cam
drawer.note: only the pull-out (out_mm) is part of the scored protocol; in_mm is kept for diagnostics

outcome.note: carried (lift) / rides (drawer): the item follows the driven body (rise >= carried_rise_mm for lifts, |d - d_driven| <= tol, rotation < follow_max_deg); stayed: |d| < stay_mm and rotation < stay_deg; disturbed: |d| >= disturbed_mm or rotation >= disturbed_deg, and not following; anything else is intermediate
